description: Drug interaction check (FDA labels) — Check 2-5 drugs (brand or generic names) against each other using FDA-approved labeling. Pulls each drug's openFDA label and searches its boxed warning, contraindications, drug interactions and warnings sections for the other drugs' generic, brand, substance and pharmacologic-class names (NSAIDs, SSRIs, statins, anticoagulants, MAOIs...). Returns the matching label sentences per direction, a severity per pair (CONTRAINDICATED / MAJOR / MODERATE / MINOR) from the sentence wording, and an overall verdict. Label text matching, not medical advice. Example: ?drugs=warfarin,ibuprofen Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_interaction_check
